logic.summary: Exit when menu.html is not framed.
Resolve parent document, body, header and menu iframe.
Create three hamburger line spans with DOM APIs.
Add mobile-nav-ready to parent body after successful initialization.
Bind button click and toggle current open state.
Bind resize to close at 768px or wider.
Display current subcategory when menu_id_2 exists.
Use menu as parent iframe ID.
Set iframe height from body scroll/offset height.

styles.description: Scope responsive overrides to max-width 767px, preserve PC/tablet layout, provide CSS fallback and off-canvas menu states activated by mobile-nav-ready/mobile-menu-open.

constraints: Do not duplicate menu link definitions outside menu.html.
Do not change disp or set_height implementation.
Do not convert legacy Shift_JIS/CP932 HTML files to UTF-8.
Do not deploy to production FTP in this implementation step.
Do not insert external input through innerHTML.
invariants: PC/tablet left-side menu remains visible at 768px and wider.
Scientific body text and equation images remain unchanged.
JavaScript failure must not hide the page body.
